posting.fund.funds_off.en: Funds are turned off, so a journal line can't carry a fund. Remove the fund from the line, or turn funds on in Accounting settings.

posting.fund.unknown.en: Fund {fund} doesn't exist. Choose one of the company's funds.

posting.fund.archived.en: The fund {fund} is archived and takes no new postings. Unarchive it first, or choose another fund.

posting.fund.unbalanced.en: The lines of {fund} don't balance: they are off by {difference} {currency}. Each fund's debits must equal its credits.

posting.fund.restricted_net_assets_needs.en: A line on account {code}, restricted net assets, must carry a restricted fund.

posting.fund.retained_earnings_restricte.en: A line on account {code}, retained earnings, can't carry the restricted fund {fund}. Restricted money is recorded on restricted net assets.

fund.not_enabled.en: Funds are turned off. Turn them on in Accounting settings before adding a fund.

fund.not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this fund. It may belong to another company.

fund.name_taken.en: There is already a fund named {name}. Choose another name.

fund.purpose_required.en: A restricted fund needs a purpose: what the money may be spent on.

fund.restriction_locked.en: {fund} already has postings, so whether it is restricted and its purpose can't change. Create a new fund and move the money to it instead.

fund.balance_held.en: These funds still hold balances: {funds}. Bring each to zero first.

posting.fund.stock_unrestricted.en: A line on account {code}, which holds stock or its cost, can't carry the restricted fund {fund}. Stock and its cost are held unrestricted.

posting.fund.movement_outside.en: This entry moves money of {fund} between funds. Restricted money moves only through Transfer between funds, Release from restriction or Reallocate restricted funds.

posting.fund.movement_needs_user.en: Money of {fund} moves between funds only when a person posts the movement, never by an automatic posting.

posting.fund.movement_permission.en: Moving money of {fund} between funds needs the {permission} permission.

posting.fund.movement_template.en: This movement of {fund} doesn't fit its type. A transfer moves money between unrestricted funds, a release takes restricted money to an unrestricted fund, a reallocation moves it to a restricted fund with the same purpose, and an opening assigns unrestricted balances to funds. Each one only moves balance-sheet accounts between funds.

posting.fund.movement_income_expense.en: Account {code} is an income or expense account. A movement between funds moves balance-sheet accounts only.

posting.fund.movement_exceeds_balance.en: {fund} holds {available} {currency} on account {code}, so it can't give {amount} {currency}.

posting.fund.reallocation_needs_authoriz.en: Reallocating money of {fund} needs a reason and a reference to the donor's written authorization.

posting.fund.opening_restricted_negative.en: This opening would leave the net assets of {fund} below zero. Assign the assets that cover its liabilities in the same opening.

posting.fund.release_backing_missing.en: A release from {fund} must name the purpose spending it pays for: posted expense lines, charged to no fund, that add up to the amount released.

posting.fund.release_backing_charged.en: That spending is already charged to a fund, so it can't back a release from {fund}. Only spending charged to no fund can.

posting.fund.release_backing_used.en: The spending on account {code} has already been released from restriction, so it can't back this release from {fund} as well.

posting.fund.movement_void.en: This entry moves money of {fund} between funds, so it can't be voided. Reverse it instead.

fund.movement_same_fund.en: Choose two different funds. Money can't move from a fund to itself.

fund.movement_not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this movement between funds, or it isn't posted.

fund.transfer_allocation_total.en: The amounts by fund add up to {allocated} {currency}, but the transfer moves {amount} {currency}. Change them so they add up to the amount transferred.

accounting.close_not_found.en: No close of the fiscal year ending {year_end} is posted, so there is nothing to reverse.

posting.fund.origin_fixed.en: This line came from {source}; its origin cannot be changed

posting.fund.document_origin_fixed.en: This document came from {source}; its origin cannot be changed

posting.fund.key_not_taken.en: A line carries a field these books do not take: {field}

posting.fund.choice_not_granted.en: Choose the fund for line {line} with its Fund control

posting.fund.document_choice_not_granted.en: Choose the fund for this document with its Fund for this document control

posting.fund.choice_missing.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for line {line}

posting.fund.document_choice_missing.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for this document

posting.fund.choice_line_unknown.en: This document no longer has that line. Reload it and choose again.

posting.fund.choice_local_line.en: Line {line} didn't come from outside, so it has no fund to choose. Set its fund on the line itself.

posting.fund.document_posted.en: This document has posted; use Change fund

posting.fund.inbound_key.en: This record came in with {field}, which these books set themselves now that they use funds. Remove {field} and send it again.

fund.turn_on_outside_keys.en: {count} records carry fund fields sent from outside: {records}. Post them (they post as today while funds are off) or delete them, then turn funds on.

fund.turn_off_choices_held.en: Clear or post the fund choices on {records} first

fund.choices_cleared_lines.en: Amounts changed, so the fund choices on lines {lines} were cleared: choose again

fund.choices_cleared_both.en: Amounts changed, so the fund choices on lines {lines} and the fund for this document were cleared: choose again

fund.choices_cleared_document.en: Amounts changed, so the fund for this document was cleared: choose again
